login.title: Log in
login.forgot: Forgot your PIN? Ask the manager to reset it.
login.subtitle: Enter your mobile number and 4-digit PIN.

changePin.title: Set your new PIN
changePin.intro: Choose a 4-digit PIN only you know.

join.title: Request to join
join.intro: Send your details. The manager will call you and share your login PIN.
join.done: Request sent. We'll contact you soon.

users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.pinHint: Share it on WhatsApp now. It won't be shown again, and they must change it on first login.
users.confirmReset: Reset the PIN for {{name}}? Their current PIN stops working.
users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {{name}}? They won't be able to log in.
users.sub: Who can log in, and what they can do.
users.shopsHint: Shop logins are created from the Shops page, so they are linked to the right shop.

joinRequests.title: Join requests
joinRequests.approveHint: This creates the shop and its login. Set its route and credit terms.
joinRequests.approvedCreated: Shop and login created. Share the PIN with the owner.
joinRequests.sub: Shops that asked to join from the login screen.
joinRequests.emptyHint: New requests from shops show up here.

errors.LOCKED: Too many wrong tries. Try again after {{time}}.
errors.ALREADY_REGISTERED: This number already has an account. Log in instead.
errors.ALREADY_PENDING: A request from this number is already waiting.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests today. Try tomorrow.
errors.PHONE_EXISTS: A user with this number already exists.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.NETWORK: Couldn't reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.crashed: This screen didn't load. Tap Reload to try again.
errors.SHOP_PHONE_EXISTS: A shop with this phone number already exists. Search for it in the list.
errors.SHOP_HAS_HISTORY: This shop has orders or khata entries, so it can't be deleted. Untick "Shop is active" instead.
errors.EMPTY_PRICE_LIST: Add at least one price before making the list live.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Not found. Refresh and try again.
errors.CUTOFF_PASSED: Ordering for this delivery has closed. Your order will go on the next delivery.
errors.ORDER_LOCKED: This order is already loaded on the truck and cannot be changed.
errors.NO_PRICE_LIST: Prices are being updated. Please try again in a while.
errors.NO_DELIVERY: No delivery is scheduled for your route. Please call the manager.
errors.ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: One of the items is no longer available. Please check your order.
errors.SHOP_INACTIVE: This shop is not active. Please call the manager.
errors.PIN_UNKNOWN: This PIN was set before PINs were recorded. Reset it to get a new one.
errors.CREDIT_BLOCKED: Ordering is paused because a payment is overdue. Please pay the driver or call the manager.
errors.CREDIT_LIMIT: This order goes over your credit limit. Please pay some dues first or call the manager.
errors.NOT_ON_TRUCK: More than what is on the truck. Reduce the quantity.
errors.PLAN_NOT_OUT: This route is not out for delivery.
errors.APPEND_ONLY: Entries cannot be changed. Use Void instead.
errors.ORDER_EXISTS: This shop already has an open order on that trip. Edit that order instead.
errors.TRIP_EXISTS: That truck already has a trip on this route and day. Move the orders to it instead.

catalog.title: Catalogue
catalog.readOnly: Only admins can edit the catalogue.
catalog.photoHint: Tap a photo to change it

prices.title: Price lists
prices.confirmActivate: Make "{{name}}" the live price list? Shops will see these prices immediately. Past orders keep their old prices.
prices.draftHint: Draft: edit prices below, then "Make live". Leave trade price empty to remove a pack from this list.
prices.invalid: Trade price must be above 0 and above the scheme.

prices.importHint: Upload the monthly .xlsx from PepsiCo. It creates a draft for you to check before making it live.

warn.SCHEME_TOO_HIGH: scheme is not below trade price

prices.sub: Monthly PepsiCo rates. Shops always see the live list.
prices.noLive: No price list is live yet, so shops cannot order. Open the draft and press "Make live".

shops.title: Shops
shops.name: Shop name
shops.createLogins: Create logins for shops with a phone number
shops.csvHint: Columns: name, owner_name, phone, route, stop_seq, credit_limit (₹), credit_days, address, gstin, code. Route must be one of: {{routes}}.
shops.emptyHint: Add shops one by one, or import all of them from a CSV file.
shops.deleteBody: The shop and its login are removed for good. Only possible before its first order.
shops.loginExists: This shop already has a login. Reset its PIN from Users.
shops.step1: Download the template and fill one shop per row.
shops.step2: Route must be exactly one of: {{routes}}.
shops.step3: Upload the file and check the rows before importing.

auth.heroTitle: Orders, deliveries and dues in one place.
auth.heroText: Shops order from their phone. Trucks load right. Every rupee is tracked.
auth.point1: Order in seconds, before the midnight cutoff
auth.point2: Loading sheet ready for every truck
auth.secure: Secure login with your mobile number and PIN

placeholder.shopText: You will be able to see products, place orders and check your dues here.
placeholder.driverText: Today's stops, deliveries and collections will show on this screen.

shop.noDelivery: No delivery is scheduled for your route yet. Please call the manager.
shop.savedOrder: Your order is saved: {{n}} cases, {{total}}. Change anything below and press Update.
shop.reordered: Added your last order. Check it and place it.
shop.noProductsHint: Prices for this month are not live yet. Please try later.
shop.payNote: You pay only for what is delivered. Pay the driver in cash or UPI.
shop.placedText: You can change or cancel it until the cutoff. The driver brings it on the delivery day.
shop.noOrdersHint: Your orders will show up here.

dash.title: Next delivery
dash.allOrdered: Every shop on these routes has ordered.

orders.title: Orders
orders.empty: No orders for this day yet
orders.emptyHint: Orders from shops appear here. Use "Take an order" for phone orders.
orders.lockedNote: The truck is loaded, so this order can no longer change.
orders.todayLoaded: The {{route}} truck for this day is already loaded. Undo loading on the Loading page, or pick another trip.
orders.vehicleHint: The vehicle is set for the whole trip. You can still change it on the Loading page.
orders.noOtherTrips: No other open trips on this day. Use New order to add a trip.
orders.moveHint: Only trips not yet loaded are shown.

loading.title: Loading sheet
loading.sub: What each truck carries. Lock it before the truck leaves.
loading.noPlans: No deliveries in the next two weeks
loading.overCapacity: {{n}} cases more than this truck holds. Choose a bigger vehicle or reduce spares.
loading.addSpare: Add spare stock for van sales
loading.confirmLock: Lock this load? {{n}} orders will be frozen and shops can no longer change them.
loading.confirmUnlock: Unlock? Orders can be changed again and the sheet must be locked again.
loading.locked: Load locked. Print the sheet for the helpers.
loading.noTripForTruck: No orders on this truck for this day
loading.startHint: You can still load items on it. Pick the route it will go on, then add items as spares and lock the load. Orders can be added with New order.

khata.title: Khata
khata.shopHint: Bills are made for what was delivered. Pay the driver or the office in cash or UPI.
khata.blocked: Ordering is paused: {{amount}} is due. Please pay the driver or call the manager.
khata.adminSub: What every shop owes, oldest dues first.
khata.blockedStaff: This shop cannot order from the app (overdue or over limit). You can still take phone orders.
khata.unblocked: Shop can order for the next 2 days.
khata.openingHint: Enter what the shop owed before using this app. Use a minus sign for an advance.
khata.voidHint: A correction of {{amount}} is added. The original stays visible, marked voided.

driver.noPlanHint: Tap a date above to see its orders and load the truck.
driver.staleNote: No internet. Showing data saved at {{time}}. Deliveries are saved on this phone and sync later.
driver.failedTitle: These could not be saved. Check and retry:
driver.queuedNote: Delivered and saved on this phone. It will sync when online.
driver.vanOnly: No order from this shop. Add what they take from the truck below.
driver.needReason: Choose a reason for every item delivered less than ordered.
driver.firstLoadOffline: No internet, and today's route is not saved on this phone yet. Connect once to load it; after that it works offline.
driver.searchShop: Search any shop name or phone
driver.nothingSpare: Nothing spare left on the truck to sell.
driver.confirmLoad: Lock the load: {{n}} shops, {{cases}} cases go on the truck and leave stock. Orders can no longer be changed.
driver.laterOrder: This shop also has an order for {{date}} ({{n}} cases).
driver.laterHasToday: It also has an order today. Deliver today's order; ask the office to cancel or merge the other one.

eod.title: End of day
eod.sub: Count what came back on the truck and the cash in hand. The office checks it against today's deliveries.
eod.syncFirst: {{n}} entries are still waiting to upload. Get online and let them sync first.
eod.confirmDiff: The cases or the cash are different from what was expected. The office will see this. Close anyway?
eod.needOnline: You need internet to close the day.
eod.allMatch: Everything matches. Hand the cash to the office.
eod.flagged: Differences were sent to the office.
eod.adminSub: Cash and stock each truck brought back, for the last 7 days.
eod.notClosed: The driver has not closed this day yet.
eod.reopenHint: The driver can make more deliveries and must close the day again. The earlier count stays in change history.

audit.title: Change history
audit.sub: Who changed what, and when. Kept forever.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.sub: {{cases}} cases in the warehouse · worth {{value}} at cost · {{low}} low
inventory.thresholdHint: Warn when cases on hand fall to (0 = off)

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.sub: Stock bought from suppliers. Saving a purchase adds the cases to inventory.
purchases.addSupplierFirst: Add a supplier before recording a purchase.
purchases.badSheet: This doesn't look like a Pepsi order sheet. It needs SKU Code, Order Qty and Order Value columns.
purchases.importHint: Pick the supplier first. Each Pepsi SKU is matched to an item once; next time it is remembered.
purchases.unmatched: {{n}} lines are not matched to an item and will be skipped.

pricing.title: Pricing & margin
pricing.sub: Minimum selling price per case from your monthly expenses and volume.
pricing.overCapacity: Planned volume is more than your trucks can carry ({{n}} cases a month). Add a truck or more trips.
pricing.how: Minimum = buy price + cost per case: below it you lose money once expenses are counted. Floor = buy price + loading and cash discount: only to fill empty truck space. Slab prices never go below the minimum.
pricing.legend: * Buy price not recorded yet; assumed trade price minus {{m}}. Import a Pepsi invoice to use the real cost. Red margin: below cost per case. Green: room to discount.
pricing.defaultMargin: Assumed margin ₹ per case (when buy price unknown)
pricing.slabApplied: {{n}} cases in this order: volume discount {{off}} per case applied (not below each minimum).
pricing.belowFloorBody: {{n}} items are priced below the floor. You lose money on every case. Save anyway?

live.title: Live deliveries
live.noneHint: Trips appear here once their load is locked.
live.tripLine: {{cases}} of {{ordered}} ordered cases · {{value}} billed · cash {{cash}} · UPI {{upi}}
